overloadcore.ward.lore: Borrow the thunder of a thousand engines. Deny the appointed end.
overloadcore.ward.equip: Use to equip, or place in the Ward accessory slot.
overloadcore.ward.details_hint: Hold Shift to reveal the price of defiance.
overloadcore.ward.scope: Thunder domain: %s blocks. Draws from owned or entrusted machines.
overloadcore.ward.price: Each reprieve costs %s FE, shared by nearby machines. No cooldown.
overloadcore.ward.rescue: At the final blow, keep half a heart and defy death.
overloadcore.ward.unfunded: Without enough power, the seal grants no reprieve.
overloadcore.ward.removable: Freely removable; can be worn alongside the Overloaded Core.
overloadcore.ward.saved: Thunder Ward: the engines pay. Your thread holds.
overloadcore.lore: Let this mortal frame mend the circuit of a broken god.
overloadcore.warning: Once worn, the pact cannot be unbound, even by death.
overloadcore.effects: Pact domain: %s blocks. Owned or entrusted machines only.
overloadcore.equip_hint: Hold use for two seconds with the pendant to seal the pact.
overloadcore.details_hint: Hold Shift to hear the whispers of the pact.
overloadcore.hold_bind: Keep holding use for two seconds. The pact will be permanent.
overloadcore.no_slot: An empty Core accessory slot is required.
overloadcore.foreign_core: This pact already bears another soul.
overloadcore.not_owner: Aim at a device you own.
death.attack.overloadcore.electric: %1$s was struck down by a short circuit
overloadcore.curse.0: Soul Weld · Bound to the circuit, beyond release or death.
overloadcore.curse.1: Thunder Tithe · Working machines demand twice the power.
overloadcore.curse.2: Eclipsed Sun · Half of all generated power feeds the void.
overloadcore.curse.3: Thunderlash · Working machines strike those who stray close.
overloadcore.curse.4: Sealed Veins · Shackled conduits carry their burden at half pace.
overloadcore.curse.5: Iron Whispers · The louder chorus turns the senses to nausea.
overloadcore.curse.6: Iron Fetters · At %s ingots of metal, your sprint is sealed.
overloadcore.curse.7: Ember Writ · Heat gathers within; at its peak, flesh burns.
overloadcore.gift.0: Twinned Forge · Chosen ores and components emerge twofold.
overloadcore.gift.1: Returning Thunder · A quarter of excess power feeds your gear.
overloadcore.gift.2: Mountain Riven · A powered MekaTool mines a quarter faster.
overloadcore.gift.3: Augury · Press %s to divine machine locations and their woes.
